cases.description: The overloaded findRRset(name, type, Section.ANSWER) is forced to return true. Because the logical OR operator is short‑circuiting, the method should return true without invoking the AUTHORITY or ADDITIONAL checks.
The ANSWER check returns false, the AUTHORITY check returns true, and the ADDITIONAL check must not be executed. The final result should be true.
Both ANSWER and AUTHORITY checks return false, the ADDITIONAL check returns true. The method should return true after evaluating the third operand.
All three overloaded findRRset calls return false, so the combined OR expression yields false.
Passing a null Name should cause a NullPointerException (the method forwards the call to the three‑argument version which dereferences the name).
A type value that is not a valid DNS RR type should not match any RRset, therefore all three checks return false and the method returns false.
A Message is constructed with an A record for example.com. in the ANSWER section. findRRset(name, type) should locate the RRset in the first section and return true.

group: Record present in AUTHORITY section only

cases.description: The Message contains an NS record for example.org. only in the AUTHORITY section. The ANSWER check returns false, the AUTHORITY check finds the RRset and returns true.

group: Record present in ADDITIONAL section only

cases.description: An A record for example.net. is added to the ADDITIONAL section. Both ANSWER and AUTHORITY checks return false, the ADDITIONAL check succeeds, yielding true.
The Message only contains an A record for example.com. A request for MX type should not match any RRset, so all three section checks return false.

group: Name does not exist but type is valid

cases.description: No records for nonexistent.com. are present in any section; the method must return false regardless of a valid type.
A SOA record for the DNS root (".") is placed in the AUTHORITY section. findRRset should locate it and return true.
Type value 0 is not a defined DNS RR type; the method should treat it as non‑matching and return false.

group: Maximum valid type with no matching RRset

cases.description: 65535 is the highest possible type value but no record of that type exists in the message; the method must return false.
